assumptions: Logical constraints can be formalized and extracted from authoritative sources.
Internal thought pathways that deviate from these constraints represent identifiable blind spots.
Self-correction is possible if the agent is provided with explicit constraint violations.
definition.falsification: If the model fails to detect discrepancies between its reasoning chain and provided formal constraints significantly better than chance, the hypothesis is falsified.
definition.statement: LLMs can identify reasoning blind spots by comparing internal chain-of-thought pathways against a set of externally-validated logical constraints derived from the same domain.
definition.uncertainty: The primary uncertainty is whether model-internal 'thought space' is sufficiently transparent to allow for constraint mapping.

withheld_actions.body: Research questions require abandonment when iterative search costs exceed the probability of finding transformative evidence. Based on the integration of reasoning blind spot analysis and search-cost optimization, we define three thresholds: 1) Divergence of heuristic exploration from verified objectives; 2) Stagnation of node generation metrics; and 3) Saturation of distinct source evidence relevance. Abandonment serves to preserve cognitive resources for high-novelty trajectories.
withheld_actions.lede: Establishing rigorous abandonment criteria requires balancing resource limits against the potential for unexpected discovery.
withheld_actions.reason: Resolves commitment commit-proj-abandonment-next-step by defining epistemic thresholds for research abandonment.
withheld_actions.title: Epistemic Thresholds for Research Question Abandonment
